$description: Lumen design tokens — canonical source of the theme-token pipeline (doc 08 §3.1, card 1.B4). Interim derivation from the pinned SVG design package (doc 08 §1); re-derive when the Figma variables export arrives (doc 08 §2). Every value is [VERIFY-DESIGN] per doc 08 §1.1-§1.4 unless its description marks it [PROPOSAL]. Figma export annotation chrome is excluded per doc 08 §1.1-1.2 (purple #8A38F5 dashed frames, 4.5px annotation radii, 20px annotation insets, artboard-scaled stroke copies 0.825/1.125/1.28571). Element sizes and layout (window 1920x1080, topbar 40, control bar 54, rail 50, playlist 377, control heights 28/32/34/36/48, item pitch 42) are NOT tokens — layout config owns them (doc 01 §2.3d). Layer grammar per doc 08 §3.2: primitive (raw, never consumed by components) -> alias (theme-role) -> semantic (the only consumable layer).

lumen.tokens.format: W3C Design Tokens draft subset (nested groups, $value/$type/$description, {dotted.path} alias references, group $type inheritance) plus one lumen extension: a $value that is a JSON object whose keys are all registered mode names is a per-mode value [PROPOSAL — doc 08 §3.1 requires per-mode values; modes are not in the DTCG draft yet]
lumen.tokens.accent-derivation: alternate-accent ramps are computed by the theme-tokens crate (doc 08 §3.3): HSL shifts calibrated on the mined orange family, on-accent glyph chosen as the first candidate with WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1 against the accent primary — the first three candidates are mined values (dark-glyph-first), the fourth (pure white, gray.0) is a [PROPOSAL — card 1.B4-R] fallback added because the violet accent reaches 4.5:1 against none of the mined values [re-pin when the Figma file provides the real ramps]
lumen.tokens.provenance: doc 08 §1.2 (hex frequency), §1.3 (typography from outlined-text cap-heights), §1.4 (radii, spacing, strokes, shadows, blur); mined 2026-10 from design/figma/ (102 SVG exports)

primitive.$description: Layer 1 of 3 (doc 08 §3.2): raw, extraction-accurate values. Never consumed by components; exists for re-derivation and diffing against the future Figma variables. Gray long-tail consolidation per doc 08 §3.4 [PROPOSAL]: #0C0C0C->gray.900, #151515/#171717->gray.800, #1E1E1E/#202020->gray.650 (each within ~0.4pp lightness at 1x); #262626, #373737, #2E2E2E stay distinct. Gray step numbers: lightness-ranked, 900=#090909 down to 25=#EAEAEA, plus 0=#FFFFFF [PROPOSAL — card 1.B4-R on-accent fallback; doc 08 §3.2's illustrative gray.40=#AFAFAF is not reproducible alongside 24 distinct observed grays; re-pin with the Figma variables].

color.$description: Neutral ramp + accent family + special colors. Dark-theme values from doc 08 §1.2 whole-corpus fill/stroke counts.

800.$description: play-button glyph; consolidates #151515 search field (36) and #171717 (29) [PROPOSAL]

750.$description: secondary surface: icon rail, menus, dropdown list, EQ panel (298)

700.$description: topbar / control bar / window border / music bg (64 + border stroke)

650.$description: hover / selected item fill; consolidates #1E1E1E (4) and #202020 (1) [PROPOSAL]

550.$description: misc deeper surface (50); kept distinct from gray.600 (1.6pp lightness)

525.$description: light-theme icons/labels; dark misc deeper surface (11)

500.$description: thumbnail/placeholder base, EQ outer (114); also light-theme text

450.$description: misc deeper surface (39); kept distinct from gray.500

350.$description: tertiary/disabled text, OFF labels (501); doubles as light-theme tertiary [PROPOSAL]

300.$description: primary icon/label gray, the workhorse foreground (1716 fills + 3221 strokes)

200.$description: secondary text bright (36); the gray accent swatch; light onboarding theme-card fill

175.$description: [PROPOSAL] light raised surface — derived (surface mirror rule), not observed

150.$description: secondary text brighter, dark (86); light selected fill [PROPOSAL assignment]

125.$description: [PROPOSAL] light hover fill — derived (surface mirror rule), not observed

25.$description: brightest text (miniplayer titles, 54); light on-accent candidate

0.$description: [PROPOSAL — card 1.B4-R] pure white; not mined — final on-accent fallback for accents (violet) that reach 4.5:1 against none of the mined grays; step 0 continues the lightness-ranked numbering

orange.$description: The product accent family (doc 08 §1.2): primary + 4 tonal variants + light progress tint. Step numbers 300/500/600/700 per doc 08 §3.2; 200/400 inserted for the light-theme variants [PROPOSAL — the scale is not lightness-monotonic at 400 (43.1%) vs 500 (46.1%); re-pin with the Figma variables].

400.$description: light-theme accent icon tints (3) [PROPOSAL step number]

500.$description: primary accent: play button, seek knob, ON toggle label, selected swatch, onboarding primary button, selection rings (381)

600.$description: darker accent: ON-knob, EQ thumbs, pressed/hover accent fills (232)

700.$description: accent-tinted dark fill: seek progress, segmented selected, toggle ON track (189)

accent.$description: The 8 alternate accent primaries — settings 'Accent color' swatches, drawn at 70% rest opacity (doc 08 §1.2). The 9th (default) accent is orange.500. Derivative steps are computed (see $extensions.accent-derivation).

viz.$description: Audio-visualizer gradient key stops (50 stops each; red->orange->gold->lime, doc 08 §1.2). The orange stop is orange.500.

dusk.$description: Solstice sunset stops, dark mode (sampled from the Keyvox reference)

paper.$description: Solstice sticky-note family, light mode (Keyvox card)

font.$description: Type scale from outlined-text cap-heights (doc 08 §1.3): font-size = cap/0.72, rounded [VERIFY-DESIGN]. Family/weights are interim [PROPOSAL] — exports carry no font metadata; re-derive when the Figma file arrives.

time.$description: cap 11.1px, tabular digits (00:02:10) — condensed/tabular face distinctness is [VERIFY-DESIGN]

regular.$description: [PROPOSAL] two weights inferred from outline stroke thickness (doc 08 §1.3) [VERIFY-DESIGN]

medium.$description: [PROPOSAL] headers vs body suggest regular + medium/bold

radius.$description: Working ramp per doc 08 §1.4 [PROPOSAL over VERIFY-DESIGN data]: 1/2/4/6/10/12/14/19 with 21/30 kept distinct. Consolidations [PROPOSAL]: 3 (188) -> 4; 5 (163) -> 6; 20 (album art) -> 19; 4.5 (35) excluded as annotation chrome.

4.$description: buttons inner, seek fill/thumb, toggle knob [3 consolidated] (354)

6.$description: default control radius: buttons, menu items, segments, toggle, seek [5 consolidated] (559)

space.$description: 4px base grid with 8px component padding [PROPOSAL over VERIFY-DESIGN data, doc 08 §1.4]. 20px annotation padding excluded (not design).

48.$description: item pitch upper bound (42-48 observed; menu items 48) [PROPOSAL]

width.$description: Stroke widths (doc 08 §1.4): icon 1.5 (3464 uses), 2 and 3 for emphasis; ring 4 (selection rings, inset rings); window border 20. Artboard-scaled copies (0.825/1.125/1.28571) excluded.

overlay.$description: stronger variant (blur 5.9, black 70%); dy assumed 4.76 [PROPOSAL — only blur+alpha observed for this variant]

blur.$description: Backdrop blur radii (doc 08 §1.1): Figma blur 50 => 25px CSS; the 13.75px pair sits on smaller panels (Figma 27.5).

opacity.$description: Alpha carried separately from hue (doc 08 §1.2). Keys are percent.

alias.$description: Layer 2 of 3 (doc 08 §3.2): theme roles — the names we expect to recover as Figma variables. Per-mode values where the role flips between dark and light (doc 08 §1.2 light table). Light values marked [PROPOSAL] were derived (unobserved in the single light frame).

surface.$description: base surface: menus, icon rail, dropdown lists, EQ panel

surface.deep.$description: wells: seek track, chips, input bg, toggle track

surface.panel.$description: translucent panels over video (alpha via opacity.panel)

surface.chrome.$description: topbar / control bar / window border (alpha via opacity.chrome)

surface.selected.$description: selected fill; light value [PROPOSAL assignment of mined #C6C6C6]

surface.raised.$description: raised: thumbnails, EQ outer; light value [PROPOSAL] derived

surface.muted.$description: off-knob, waveform bars, tertiary fills; light value [PROPOSAL assignment of mined #ACACAC]

content.tertiary.$description: tertiary/disabled/OFF labels — same value reads dimmer-on-dark / dimmer-on-light [PROPOSAL]

content.bright.$description: strongest text (miniplayer titles); light value [PROPOSAL assignment of mined #161616]

content.on-accent.$description: glyph on accent fills (play glyph); per-accent contrast selection per doc 08 §3.3

accent.$description: primary accent — constant across themes (play button); per-accent

accent.bright.$description: knob accent — brightens on light; per-accent

accent.strong.$description: darker accent: ON-knob, EQ thumbs, pressed fills; per-accent

accent.tinted.$description: accent-tinted fill: seek progress, segmented selected, toggle ON track; per-accent

stroke.warm.$description: warm-dark stroke (miniplayer); same value both modes [PROPOSAL]

track-inset.$description: inner inset on filled tracks [PROPOSAL naming]

item-pitch.$description: list item pitch [PROPOSAL: upper bound of 42-48]

semantic.$description: Layer 3 of 3 (doc 08 §3.2): the ONLY layer components may consume. Every token resolves through an alias, never directly to a primitive (enforced by the parser). CSS name = --{category}-{name}; Rust const = {CATEGORY}_{NAME}. Mode-dependent tokens flip with [data-theme]; accent-family tokens flip with [data-accent] (doc 08 §3.3).

content.on-accent.$description: glyph on accent fills; switches per accent

accent.bright.$description: knob accent (bright on light); per accent
